data_preview.Official Title: An Open-Label, Multicenter, Randomized Phase 3 Study of First-Line Encorafenib Plus Cetuximab With or Without Chemotherapy Versus Standard of Care Therapy... in Participants With Metastatic BRAF V600E-Mutant Colorectal Cancer
data_preview.Intervention (Primary Agents): Drug: Encorafenib, Drug: Cetuximab, Drug: Chemotherapy (mFOLFOX6 or FOLFIRI)
data_preview.Summary of Key Inclusion Criteria: Metastatic Colorectal Cancer (mCRC); Locally confirmed BRAF V600E-mutant; Previously untreated (0 prior regimens) in the metastatic setting (Safety Lead-in allows 0-1); ECOG PS 0-1; Measurable disease.
data_preview.Summary of Key Exclusion Criteria: Locally confirmed or unknown MSI-H or dMMR (unless ineligible for ICIs); Symptomatic brain metastases; Active bacterial or viral infections within 2 weeks prior to dosing.

data_preview.Official Title: A Single-Arm, Phase II Study of Autophagy Modulation Using Hydroxychloroquine in Combination With Encorafenib and Cetuximab or Panitumumab in Metastatic BRAF-mutated Colorectal Cancer Refractory to Standard Therapies
data_preview.Intervention (Primary Agents): Drug: Hydroxychloroquine, Drug: Encorafenib, Drug: Cetuximab or Panitumumab
data_preview.Summary of Key Inclusion Criteria: Metastatic BRAF V600E-mutated Colorectal Cancer; Progression on at least 1 prior line of therapy (refractory); ECOG PS 0-1; Adequate organ and bone marrow function.
data_preview.Summary of Key Exclusion Criteria: Prior chemotherapy or radiotherapy ≤14 days prior to study start; Symptomatic or untreated/unstable leptomeningeal disease or spinal cord compression; History of acute MI or coronary syndromes within 6 months; Current risk factors for Retinal Vein Occlusion (RVO) or severe eye disease.

data_preview.Official Title: SX-682 and Nivolumab for the Treatment of RAS-Mutated, MSS Unresectable or Metastatic Colorectal Cancer, the STOPTRAFFIC-1 Trial
data_preview.Summary of Key Inclusion Criteria: Histologically confirmed adenocarcinoma of the colon or rectum that is metastatic or unresectable; Tumor is RAS-mutated (KRAS or NRAS) and microsatellite stable (MSS) / proficient in mismatch repair (pMMR); Received at least two prior regimens of therapy for unresectable or metastatic CRC; ECOG PS 0-1; Measurable disease (RECIST v1.1).
data_preview.Summary of Key Exclusion Criteria: Major surgery within 4 weeks; Prior treatment with an IDO inhibitor or PD-1/PD-L1/CTLA-4 inhibitor; Untreated or symptomatic brain metastases, or those requiring corticosteroids.
